import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { reports } from "../../../backend/schema/reports";

export const reportsCms = customizeTable<typeof reports>("reports", {
    display: {
        title: "details"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "category", "issue", "user", "details", "createdAt"],
    fields: {
        details: {
            multiline: true
        },
        category: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "category", "issue", "user", "details", "createdAt", "updatedAt"]
});
